node.title: Splitting in while loop
node.author: tel2
node.doctext:
Beloved Monks,

Any ideas why my code below doesn't split the email addresses into lines of 1 address per line, each in single quotes? while (split(/[, ]+/, )) { chomp; print "'$_'\n"; } __DATA__ me@here.com those@there.com others@there.com you@there.com,them@there.com I'm getting this output: '' '' '' But I was wanting/expecting this output: 'me@here.com' 'you@there.com' 'them@there.com' 'those@there.com' 'others@there.com' How can it be changed to generate my expected output?

If someone has a completely different approach, I'm open to it, but I'd like to understand what I'm doing wrong, too, please.

Note: The real code will have the email addresses in a separate file, but I've put them under __DATA__ here for convenience.

Thanks.
Tel2
